messages:
oliver: FYI HelixCorp escalated to execs. CTO wants single-slide summary of blockers + proposed mitigations by tomorrow noon. main asks: VPC peering diagram, SSO test tenant, completed security questionnaire, and rough pilot cost estimate.

priya: copying. i'll own the slide. need exact ask list so we don't miss anything. do they require dedicated hardware for pilot or is hosted ok?

oliver: Linda said they prefer Dedicated for isolation but will accept hosted if we can guarantee egress controls. she's leaning Dedicated for compliance.

tom: on Dedicated: we can provision a 2-GPU carve for pilot but infra needs 48h notice. caveat: advertized latency SLOs assume our standard seq length distribution; if they run long-context, cost and perf change.

rachel: i've pulled the security questionnaire from the deal binder (sec-2026-helix.docx). i'll start filling in network and incident response. any history on Helix requirements around data residency?

oliver: they flagged EU residency for some datasets. legal will need to review, but for the pilot they can keep EU data in our eu-west region.

security-bot: Quick note: HelixCorp requested encryption-at-rest with BYO-KMS and HSM attestation. If customer insists on FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestation, procurement lead time is 3+ weeks.

priya: good to call that out. we should give two options on the slide: (A) pilot with BYO-KMS key-wrap + audit logs (2-3 day turnaround) or (B) full HSM attestation path (3-5 week timeline).

tom: for the SSO test tenant: we support SCIM and SAML. sample SCIM mapping for Okta:
```
scim:
  groups:
    - name: engineers
      remote: /OktaGroups/ENG
    - name: analysts
      remote: /OktaGroups/ANLY
```
Tell them to create a test org with an admin user so infra can bind.

rachel: i'm adding that snippet to the questionnaire answers and a one-click checklist for their admin. also adding retention defaults (30d logs, 90d telemetry) unless they request otherwise.

oliver: Pricing: Priya, can you sketch a pilot model: reserved baseline + per-token overage and an optional network isolation premium? customer asked for a ballpark.

priya: draft numbers: Baseline (2x A5000 equiv): $25k/mo reserved, overage $0.0008/token, isolation premium +$6k/mo. will refine after we get expected token throughput.

security-bot: Reminder: attach SOC2 controls mapping and our pen-test report. I'll post links once rachel finishes the sec doc.

infra-oncall: Created ticket INF-1129 for Okta test tenant provisioning. ETA 24h; please include Okta admin contact in the ticket.

oliver: Action list for slide pack:
- rachel: sec questionnaire + SOC2 mapping (due tonight 20:00 PT)
- tom/infra: SCIM/SAML config + SSO ticket (INF-1129) (ETA 24h)
- priya: pilot pricing + two-path timeline (draft 10:00 PT tomorrow)
- legal: residency note and DOC redlines (oliver to ping)

priya: will also add callouts: HSM attestation lead time, Dedicated provision lead time (48h), and that egress IP allowlist will be required for EU peering.

rachel: i'll upload the filled questionnaire to the binder and paste the link here when done. expect ~19:30 PT.

oliver: Great. i'll assemble slide and send to Linda + VP Eng after sign-off from Priya. If anything slips, escalate here and @oliver.

infra-oncall: Reminder scheduled: follow-up INF-1129 in 12h.

priya: one more blocker to mention: if Helix wants packet capture for traffic inspection we need a signed DPA addendum. flagging for legal.

oliver: noted. thanks team. short and sharp on the slide.
